title: apricity-daw collection.rs: numbered clip files for a collection's items, atomically
description:
## Intent

Write a collection's items as numbered clip files.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/collection.rs`: for each item, the file name `NN <names::clip_file_name(...)>.alc` (`NN` two digits, three when more than 99 items), contents from the shared `.alc` writer, audio referenced from the library's files; the same partial-folder-then-rename atomicity as M3's clip folder (reuse it, do not copy it).
- Every item problem collected with the collection name, position, clip and sample path; nothing written when any item fails.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test conformance
```
The clip-file scenarios of `features/daw/collection-folder.feature` pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): a collection as numbered clip files`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the collection-read task and M3's folder writer (apricitus-3d8246).
